title: Quick Revision — Dynamics
notes: - **Newton's first law:** inertia — no net force ⇒ no change in velocity.
- **Newton's second law:** F_net = ma = dp/dt; mass measures inertia.
- **Newton's third law:** F_AB = −F_BA, forces act on different bodies.
- **Momentum** p = mv; **impulse** J = FΔt = Δp (impulse–momentum theorem).
- **Conservation of momentum:** total momentum constant when ΣF_external = 0 (collisions, recoil, rockets).
- **Torque:** τ = F·d (perpendicular distance); equilibrium needs ΣF = 0 and Στ = 0.
- **Friction:** f ∝ N; static friction ≤ μ_sN; kinetic friction = μ_kN; μ_s > μ_k; independent of contact area (per the laws).
- **Real-life links:** crumple zones and airbags stretch collision time so average force F = Δp/Δt falls.
